extracted.name: California Farm Whole Turkey Goulash and Chili
extracted.description: When the annual frozen turkey sales start again, end of summer, time to make turkey goulash and chili and freeze for the year. We are not fond of whole frozen turkeys as a dinner for two, too much meat, but when made into 12 goulash dinners with gravy and vegetables, herbs and spices, and 12 chili dinners, and frozen, great make-ahead dinners. No dairy products are used, stays fresh for a year when frozen. Goulash served over home made pasta fettucini (see cookpad recipe), steamed potatoes or wild rice and a side of cranberry marmelade. Chili served with grated cheese on top.
ingredient_lines: 14 pound Whole hen turkey, 12 pounds meat,skin and fat, 2 pounds carcass
6 Tbs Sweet red Hungarian paprika powder
instruction_lines: Thaw turkey in cold water with Tbs of seasalt, bake whole in 2 hours or cut backbone out with scissors along the ribs, split breastbone, bake breast down in 450F degree preheated oven, half hour, then another half hour at 350F degrees, cool. Debone and chop skin and organs, chop meat. Use carcass to make condensed broth. Dispose of bones in garden fermenter.

For goulash, In dutch oven, glaze onions and garlic with flour in cup of olive oil with the turkey pan drippings till golden, about 30 minutes. Add cups of condensed broth, balsamic vinegar, tomato paste, spices, herbs, simmer till fragrant. Add chopped meat and vegetables, simmer three hours, taste every hour. Add spices as desired. Remove lemon grass stalk. Mix well, store in freezer tubs. Enjoy.
For chili, Add onions, garlic, pepper, celery, jalapeño, oregano, bay leaves, chili powder and cumin to chopped cooked turkey meat. Heat for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, chicken broth, salt and pepper, taste, boil, simmer 15 minutes.
Add cooked beans, cook ten minutes longer. Serve with cheddar and sour cream. Enjoy.
